title: Lion cub reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- floor shadow suggestion omitted, no background -->
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='40' height='26' rx='3' fill='#2e8b57'/>
  <rect x='33' y='65' width='34' height='20' rx='2' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- book pages/spine -->
  <rect x='48' y='62' width='4' height='26' fill='#1f6b42'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='66' x2='50' y2='84' stroke='#d9c89a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- cub body behind book -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#e8b04b'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='70' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#d99a35'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='70' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#d99a35'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='66' r='4.5' fill='#f7d98a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='66' r='4.5' fill='#f7d98a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#f0b84e'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='24.5' fill='none' stroke='#c97f26' stroke-width='6' stroke-dasharray='5 4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='21' r='7' fill='#f0b84e'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='21' r='7' fill='#f0b84e'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='21' r='3.5' fill='#f7d98a'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='21' r='3.5' fill='#f7d98a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#fbe3a8'/>
  <!-- eyes looking down at book -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='35' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='35' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='33.5' r='1.2' fill='#fff6dd'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33.5' r='1.2' fill='#fff6dd'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M47 44 L53 44 L50 48 Z' fill='#8a4a1c'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 48 Q46 52 43 50' fill='none' stroke='#8a4a1c' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 48 Q54 52 57 50' fill='none' stroke='#8a4a1c' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='38' y1='45' x2='28' y2='43' stroke='#c98a3a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='48' x2='28' y2='49' stroke='#c98a3a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='45' x2='72' y2='43' stroke='#c98a3a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='48' x2='72' y2='49' stroke='#c98a3a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tiny tail tuft peeking -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='80' r='4' fill='#c97f26'/>
</svg>
